name: Tally
author: jmad
description: A tally light for OBS: dim while it is closed, lit while the stream is live

barWidget.description: A record dot that dims while OBS is closed, sits plain while it is open, and lights up while the stream is live

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often OBS is asked what it is doing.

schema.label: Silence notifications while live
schema.description: Turn do not disturb on for the length of the stream, and leave it as it was found.

schema.label: Hold the screen awake while live
schema.description: Keep the idle lock and the screensaver off for the length of the stream.

schema.label: Say when the stream starts and ends
schema.description: A notification as the stream goes live, and another as it ends.
